subject.title: [Bug]: Chrome MCP existing-session `profile=user` reports ready but all page tools time out on macOS

question: Should OpenClaw treat Chrome permission-gated `profile=user` page-tool timeouts as a supported wrapper bug to fix, or as an unsupported Chrome MCP state that should surface fast diagnostics?
rationale: Source proves the status subproblem is fixed and the page tools still delegate upstream, but only a live macOS Chrome trace can separate an OpenClaw-owned session/page-selection bug from an upstream unsupported state.

options.title: Capture and fix
options.body: Run the live macOS Chrome trace first, then repair OpenClaw page selection, reconnection, timeout, or diagnostics if the wrapper owns the failure.

options.title: Document unsupported state
options.body: If upstream Chrome DevTools MCP cannot reliably drive this Chrome mode, keep `pageReady=false` and add clear diagnostics and workaround docs.

options.title: Defer to broader Chrome MCP work
options.body: Only hand this to a broader Chrome MCP PR if that PR includes exact `profile=user` macOS proof for the timed-out page tools.

recommendation.title: Capture and fix
recommendation.body: Run the live macOS Chrome trace first, then repair OpenClaw page selection, reconnection, timeout, or diagnostics if the wrapper owns the failure.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and recently merged the page-readiness status work that bounds the remaining decision.
